biography: Luciano Mottin's journey began amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo, not on the asphalt, but on the dusty dirt tracks of his family's farm. He wasn't born into racing royalty; instead, his first taste of speed came strapped to the seat of an old go-kart his grandfather cobbled together from spare parts. This kart, affectionately nicknamed 'The Beetle,' became his obsession, the genesis of a burning passion. A local karting championship win at 16, against wealthier, better-equipped rivals, caught the eye of a junior racing scout, setting him on his professional path. His defining moment came during a torrential downpour at Interlagos in a Formula Regional race, where he clawed his way from last to third with breathtaking overtakes, showcasing his raw talent and fearless aggression. Now at 26, driving for MM AJR #35 with A.Mocanu Skin, Mottin finds himself at what should be his peak, battling to iron out the inconsistencies that have plagued him.
drivingStyle: Mottin is a driver who thrives on the edge. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often borders on recklessness, always searching for the absolute limit of grip. Tire management is a constant struggle, as his aggressive style tends to chew through rubber. Under pressure, Mottin's inconsistency shines through; sometimes he elevates his game to a world-class level, other times he crumbles under the weight, making unforced errors.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue bracelet his grandmother gave him before every race.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song exactly three times before putting on his helmet.
Refuses to eat anything red the day before a race, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Sometimes you have to risk it all to win it all. Second place is the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Regional Americas Championship in 2020 after a season-long battle, securing his ticket to higher levels of motorsport.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out on the first lap of his debut Formula 2 race after an overly ambitious overtake, drawing harsh criticism and denting his confidence.
